Invention field

The present invention relates generally to battery, and relate more specifically to lithium-ion battery.

Background of invention

Lithium is most light and most strong electropositive element, and this causes its application for being very suitable for needing high-energy-density.With regard to this For point, lithium-ion (Li+) battery has been successfully used in various portable electric appts and other electronic equipments.So And Li+Slowly diffusing into anode and negative electrode neutralization, slowly diffusion is still the charge and discharge to these batteries between two electrodes Two major limitations of electric speed.

Because the high surface area of nano structural material is to the ratio of volume, thus them are had proven to Li+Battery be it is useful, Have shown that cause lithiation invertibity is stronger and the bigger property of discharge rate.In addition, because reduce electrode material The granular size of material, so having shown that the nano-wire array of both manufacture carbon based anode and a variety of conventional cathode materials enhances Electrode performance, while the electrical contact of grain and grain is maintained, shorten Li+The distance that ion must spread.

Specifically, the charge rate/discharge rate and Li of battery+Into the diffusion rate of each electrode and in negative electrode Diffusion rate between anode is relevant.Although having shown that nano wire circulates faster than bulk material, shorten anode The distance between battery structure and cathode cell structure are simultaneously remarkable, although and the cathode/anode of nanostructured previously made Used in Li+In battery, but it is such use primarily to the surface area of increase negative electrode or anode or both is to the ratio of volume, And therefore, when lithium-ion needs the traveling long range between the electrode of macroscopic separation, Li+Diffusion length still It is very big.

It is therefore an object of the present invention to provide a kind of effective for increasing Li+Diffusion between galvanic anode and negative electrode The lithium-ion battery of speed.

Detailed description of the invention

Briefly, the present invention includes a kind of lithium-ion (Li+) battery and a kind of method for manufacturing this battery, Lithium-ion (the Li+) battery have include electrochemical coating have polymer dielectric and by cathode substrate surround and with the moon The anode of the electrically commoned nano-wire array of pole matrix, thus form the electrode of IPN.The battery structure of the present invention passes through shortening Li+Diffusion length between a cathode and an anode and increase Li+Diffusion rate between the two electrodes.Can construct has Long life-span and it is capable of the small and light battery of repid discharge.

According to embodiment of the present invention, the nanostructured of high length-diameter ratio (for example, such as nano wire, nanobelt, receive Mitron and nanocone) array have make a size big 10 to 1000 times with smaller size (for example, diameter of line) Size (such as length), the less size can have a nano level size, and the array of the nanostructured of high length-diameter ratio can be with Formed on conductive, typically plane substrate.Also the nanometer rods of 10 draw ratio can be formed with less than.Below In, term " nano wire " will use as the example of " nanostructured ".

Dendritic growth of the lithium metal on the graphite anode generally used can cause battery short circuit, thereby increases and it is possible to trigger safety to ask Topic.Therefore, it is necessary to new anode material and form, wherein with graphite-phase ratio, these safety problems and capacity and charge/discharge speed Rate can access improvement.Intermetallic compound provide improved capacity, with the reaction of the high reversible of lithium and may not Such as the possibility of the negative lithium insertion potential of the deposition potential of lithium metal, the deposition potential that lithium insertion potential may be not so good as lithium metal is born Property be useful for eliminating dendritic growth of the element lithium on electrode.Anode material is used as using intermetallic compound The irreversible loss of capacity during shortcoming is circulation, this is due to big Volume Changes and causes electrode to be crushed during circulation, And therefore, cause the loss of the electrical contact between the remaining part of Anode and battery.Cu2Sb be during charging and discharging not The intermetallic components of big Volume Changes occur.Cu2Sb another benefit is that its work potential prevents lithium metal from electroplating. Cu2The use of Sb nano wires has other benefit：Electrode with nano-grade size usually can be avoided because of big volume change Change and crush, even if compared with the electrode with micron order size.

Just as will be described, can be by Cu by accurately controlling composition and thickness under mild conditions2Sb It is deposited directly in conductive substrate, and is deposited directly to being connect in shape with the depression of depth and with excellent electricity for complexity Touch, without post-weld annealed.Cu and Sb is co-deposited from the aqueous solution and faces two challenges：In aqueous, Cu and Sb also Former potential differs about 130mV, and Cu deposition is preferably carried out under the less potential of negative value；And although antimonic salt is acid molten It is solvable in liquid, but they can precipitate to form Sb in neutral aqueous solution2O3.Due to H2It is from H2What O reduction was formed, institute With not as reducing Sb3+Under the negative potential of required potential, it is impossible to carry out Sb electro-deposition in an acidic solution.Citric acid (C6H8O7) can be used to the Sb in solution3+Be maintained in acid weaker solution and/or make its reduction potential be displaced to negative value compared with Small potential.Due to three hydroxy-acid groups and a hydrocarbyl group of citric acid, so it is used separately as the heavy of copper and antimony Complexing agent in product solution.The Sb obtained by the citrate material in solution3+Complexing allow pH raise without formed Sb2O3, and cause the electrochemical window of solution to broaden and towards more negative potential shift.

Using citric acid as complexing agent, have been realized in from the copper including required stoichiometric amount to antimony (with regard to Cu2Sb and Speech) the aqueous solution Direct gold electrowinning category between component Cu2Sb, so as to increase the solubility of antimonic salt and make the reduction of copper and antimony electric Gesture is offset toward each other, and can at room temperature and in pH=6 Direct precipitation intermetallic compound.Carried out in copper substrate Electro-deposition has obtained uniform, stoichiometry and crystallization Cu2Sb films.

One embodiment of this method forms passage battle array using anodised aluminium (AAO) technology in alumina substrate Row.Under single electrochemical potential, make Cu2Sb is deposited in nanochannel.Intermetallic compound Cu2Sb is shown as Li+ The premium properties of anode in battery：(a) charge storage capacity of increase；(b) increased charge rate and discharge rate；With (c) lithium metal reduced is electroplated onto the danger on anode.Other intermetallic compounds also show that these performances and can be same Sample is used as anode with flying colors.Once suitable anode material is deposited in nanochannel, removed using the chemical technology of standard AAO templates.Remaining nanostructured (is Cu in the situation of the present invention2Sb nano wires) array as with high surface area Nanostructured anode.Caused nanostructured can show high length-diameter ratio, generally straight with several nanometers to hundreds of nanometers magnitudes Footpath and tens nanometer to hundreds of micron dimensions length.

Then, the polymer deposits of electric insulation can be made on anode, conformally coated with nano line and as battery be electrolysed Matter.The effect of electrolyte is to allow Li+By, and high resistance is provided electrical conduction (i.e. electronics or electric current passes through).Although Li can be conducted+Any insulating materials be all suitable, but its should generally conformally apply be very thin layer, This will not significantly change the shape of the nano wire in array.One example is poly- (pyridine) zinc complex of electrochemical deposition, Poly- (pyridine) zinc complex is to use reduction technique from [three (4- methyl -4 '-vinyl -2,2 '-bipyridyl) Zn] (PF6)2It is made , although other insulating polymers can also be electrochemically deposited or additionally by method known to those skilled in the art It is deposited (including polyethylencarbonate derivative).Select the thickness and material of electrolyte so that electrolyte is generally electric exhausted Edge, but the shape of nano wire is not twisted generally.Insulating materials can be with being identical for conformal electrolyte coating Material, but can be any other electrically insulating material, insulating materials covers the surface of the exposure of flat conductive substrate.It is logical Often, the thickness of electrolyte can be between about one nanometer to about hundreds of nanometers.

Cathode material can be introduced so that the nano wire of the coating in array is further capped, and cathode material is manufactured Made electrical contact with into second electrode.Any suitable Li+Battery cathode material can be with, for example LiCoO2、LiMnO2With Li2SnO3Or phosphate is used together.This material can be deposited in many ways.The sol-gel process being described below is permitted Perhaps cathode material is evenly distributed in the nano-wire array of coating.

The intermetallic material with the crystal structure similar with the homologue of its lithiumation is found, because parent and product two The crystal structure of person is similar, so needing less rearrangement during the charging and discharging of material, is become so as to reduce volume Change.Antimony copper is a kind of such intermetallic compound, has the face-centered cubic in the crystal structure of both parent and product Antimony atoms in array.The similitude of crystal structure causes to work as Cu2Sb lithiumations are Li395% cumulative volume change (phase occurs during Sb Than in Sn 300%).Have proven to Cu2The improvement of Sb cycle life, 1914mAhml is maintained after 35 circulations-1Appearance Amount.In addition, during charging and discharging, because the nano-grade size of the intrinsic property of material and line, Cu2Sb nanometers Line should be less prone to degrade than graphite.

Previously to Cu2Pulpous state of the research of Sb battery performance including the use of the active material mixed with binding agent and carbon black Thing, because binding agent is used for powder being connected to electrode, so as to establish electrical contact, and material is allowed to be subjected to significant body Product change, without losing the electrical contact with current-collector.To reproduce this soft matrix, graphite flake is evaporated to copper substrate On, then, make Cu2Sb is electrodeposited on graphite.Graphite as " soft " interface adapts to Cu2Sb Volume Changes, are protected simultaneously Hold the electrical contact to substrate.Maintain 200mAhg-1Stabilization capacity, however, the Cu on Cu2In the case of Sb, capacity Drastically decline until reaching minimum value 24mAhg during preceding several circulations-1.It was found that graphite makes reversible capacity improve a number Magnitude.It is investigated change of the circulation volume with film thickness.When film is thinning, it is found that the capacity of film maintains following for more numbers Ring.Cu2Sb nano wire is expected to the even stronger ability that capacity is maintained in repetitive cycling, because prepared Film micron thickness be more than nano wire radius.In addition, the drawing due to Volume Changes is more adapted to than in film in nano wire Tightly, it is only restrained in the direction of length in nano wire, and in film, it is all restrained in all three sizes.Therefore, lead to Cross and use nano level morphosis, it is possible to reduce the electrode material degraded in lithium-ion battery, because having small size Material it is longer than bulk material existence time.

The present invention is generally described, the following examples provide other details.

Embodiment 1

It is prepared by anode：

A.Cu2Sb films：First describe at room temperature, crystallization, stoichiometry Cu2Sb films are direct under single potential Directly it is electrodeposited into from the aqueous solution on copper electrode.

By including 0.025M antimony oxides (III) (Sb2O3, nanometer powder, 99.5+%Aldrich) and 0.1M copper nitrates (II) Two times of semihydrate (Cu (NO3)2, 99.9+%Aldrich) aqueous 0.4M citric acid solutions (be expressed as H3Cit, 99.5 + %Aldrich) electro-deposition Cu2Sb films, aqueous 0.4M citric acid solutions are by the way that citric acid is added to Millipore water In (18 Ω), Sb is then added again2O3It is obtained.Adding Cu (NO3)2Afterwards, Sb is helped by mechanical agitation2O3It is completely dissolved. Then, pH is made to increase to 6 by adding 5M potassium hydroxide (KOH, being identified through ACS, Fisher).By at room temperature, with relative Implement bulk electrolysis (bulk electrolysis) in -1050mV of saturation sodium calomel electrode (SSCE) potential and obtain Cu2Sb Film.In order to find optimum deposition condition, also in a planned way change temperature and potential.Carried out using three-electrode battery and potentiostat Cyclic voltammetry (CV) and deposition.Platinum guaze (platinum gauze) is used as auxiliary electrode, and SSCE is (relative to standard hydrogen electricity Pole is 0.236V) it is used as reference electrode.Platinum disk electrode (1.7mm2) or glass-carbon electrode (7.0mm2) it is used as CV work electricity Pole, and copper coin (copper flag) or golden plate electrode are used to deposit.Copper coin is with 2cm2-4cm2Area copper foil (0.25mm is thick, 99.98%Aldrich), and mechanically polished and in phosphoric acid (H using diamond polishing cream3PO4, 85%, Mallinkrodt Chemicals) in electrochemical polish less than 5s is carried out with 0.15A electric current.Use band Deposition Controller Cold boiler manufacture golden substrate.About 10nm chromium, which is evaporated on slide, is used as adhesive layer, followed by 300nm gold.It is logical Cross with carbon coating or with fixture and copper cash is connected on plate to establish electrical contact.In order to ensure that deposition occurs over just flat surface On, and there is controlled surface area, bright nail polish (nail polish) is used to the back side for the edge and copper foil for making substrate Isolation.Implement deposition under constant potential up to the period of 10 minutes.With Millipore water flushing membrane and air-dry it.

Citric acid is ternary acid；Therefore, the pH of the change of solution is detected using cyclic voltammetry, to study pH to copper and antimony The influence of deposition potential.Including Cu (NO3)2、Sb2O3The scope that pH is 1 to 8 is prepared to the solution of citric acid.Cu2+And Sb3+ Concentration be 0.1M and 0.05M respectively (before KOH is added).8 from pH 1 to pH, including pH 1 and pH 8, use 0.4M lemons 0.1M Cu (NO in lemon acid3)2With 0.025M Sb2O3(i.e. 0.05M Sb3+), using SSCE reference electrodes, platinum working electrode and Sweep speed with 250mV/s carries out cyclic voltammetry (CV).

In addition to significantly the electrochemical window of solution is increased, it is to exist which kind of citrate material increase pH, which also controls, 's.However, in pH=1, the main matter of existing citrate is that the material protonated completely (is expressed as H3Cit), exist During pH=6, HCit be present2-And Cit3-Mixture.Once electrochemical window extends towards more negative potential, then in solution Metallics reduction potential between difference in pH=6 be minimum, this pH has the additional advantage that：Somewhat acid pH Condition prevents the oxide precipitation during film deposition.It was found that big negative electrode peak is presented in -950mV by the CV of pH=6 solution, this can Promote the reduction of copper citrate dimer, followed by correspond to Sb3+Reduction the shoulder (shoulder) positioned at -1150mV.

The CV of single citric acid shows two reduction peaks；One is due to the superficial phenomenon on Pt (in -118mV), And one (in -750mV) be due to citrate material reduction.When pH increases to 6 from 1, the CV of each metal is independent Show：Cu2+Reduction peak is offset in a negative direction, and Sb3+Reduction peak is offset in the positive direction.Sink in single potential (- 1050mV) Product causes Cu2Sb formation.At conversion scan direction, with 125mV it was observed that big oxidation peak, this corresponds to Cu2Sb's goes Remove.Only it was observed that single oxidation peak, shows to be primarily present the generation of single oxidizing process with this potential.Therefore, as only Cu2+ When in pH=6 by citrate complexation, copper metal will not deposit；However, in the presence of citric acid antimony, it was observed that two are gone back Parent peak, result are Cu2Sb is deposited.

Valid density for the citric acid of deposition solution is to include 0.05M respectively by changing between 0.2M-0.8M Sb3+With 0.1M Cu2+The concentration of solution determine.When the concentration increase of citric acid, the electric current at cathode peak reduces.This can To be attributed to the copper complex formazan balance of citric acid；That is, when adding more citric acids, available free copper ion in solution Reduce.For antimony solution, the difference of anode current or cathode current is not observed, although in order to prevent Sb2O3Precipitation, Ying Cun In enough citric acids, to be complexed all antimony.In order to avoid Sb2O3Precipitation, form 0.05M Sb3+Solution, find institute The citric acid of the minimum needed is about 0.4M.Because the lower concentration of citric acid is desired for the deposition of copper, and is needed Will at least 0.4M citric acids to keep the Sb in solution3+, 0.4M citric acids are considered as effective citric acid concentration.For subsequent All solution discussed all include 0.1M Cu (NO3)2、0.025M Sb2O3With 0.4M citric acids, pH=6 is arrived in regulation.

Using above-mentioned solution condition, the research of deposition parameter is carried out.Carry out deposition film with the different potentials around negative electrode peak：Choosing Five potentials selected are -800mV (beginning at the first negative electrode peak), -900mV, -1000mV (maximum of first peak), -1100mV (beginning at the second peak) and -1200mV.The component result determined by x-ray photoelectron power spectrum (XPS) is shown with potential more Negative, Cu/Sb ratio reduces.Relative to desired 2/1 copper/antimony ratio, the film of copper-rich is deposited with the smaller potential of negative value, and rich The film of antimony is deposited with negative value bigger potential.The film deposited between -1000mV and -1100mV have found desired ratio. This identical trend is also observed in the X-ray spectrum (EDS data) of corresponding energy-dispersive.

X-ray diffraction (XRD) figure be used to, with the Discriminating materials of the film of various potentials deposition, use including for pH=6 0.1M Cu(NO3)2、0.025M Sb2O3With the solution of 0.4M citric acids.Cu substrates cause 43 °, 50 ° and 74 ° 2 θ high intensity Three peaks, point to copper (111), (200) and (220) reflection.Three are observed in the XRD of the film deposited with -800mV Other peak.All three these peaks and Cu2Sb peak matches, and one of peak is typically used as desired compound (44 ° of 2 θ When, wide (003) peak) fingerprint image.Other Cu is not present by XPS measure2The component of Sb peaks and copper-rich shows：This film is Cu、Cu2The mixture of Sb, Sb and/or Cu and Sb solid solution.In the XRD of the film of all other potential deposition, to occur Multiple Cu2Sb peaks, show the higher film of crystallinity.With -900mV and -1000mV deposition film XRD be it is similar, still There are high relative peak intensities than the film deposited with -900mV with the peak of the film of -1000mV depositions.Because all films be all Deposited under the same amount of time, so increased peak intensity is probably due to increased crystallinity or is only bigger growth Speed.Although ESEM (SEM) figure of these films displays that similar configuration of surface, with the film ratio of -900mV depositions Bigger feature is shown with -1000mV the films deposited.With the granularity of the film of -1000mV depositions also film than being deposited with -900mV It is small.As Scherer methods are calculated, using the film of -900mV growths by being formed with particle of the average-size as 90nm, and with - The average-size of the particle of the film of 1000mV depositions is 35nm.

The film deposited in the form of the film that -1100mV and -1200mV is deposited with its XRD and with -900mV and -1000mV Figure between difference be consistent.With -1100mV, pH=6's includes 0.1M Cu (NO3)2、0.025M Sb2O3With 0.4M lemons The SEM figures of the film of the deposition solution deposition of lemon acid show dendritic growth.It was found that observe rod diameter in 50nm to 150nm's In the range of, and length is more than 600nm.The particle mean size calculated from peak broadening is 50nm, minimum equivalent to being observed from SEM Diameter.Show that small spheric granules (200nm) on the surface of the film has with the SEM figures of the film of 1200mV depositions and be less than 20nm Calculating granularity.Cu may indicate that with the XRD of the film of -1100mV to -1200mV depositions2Sb, and with the phase of prediction To intensity.It moreover has been found that orientation changes with deposition potential：It is orientated with the film that the potential born than -1100mV deposits with (111), The film being orientated relative to the display (001) with -900mV and -1000mV depositions.

For the film deposited at from 5 DEG C to 60 DEG C, Cu can detect by XPS2There is no difference in Sb membrane components.With temperature The increase of degree, the width at XRD peaks are reduced.Equally, the Cu deposited at 60 DEG C2The configuration of surface of Sb films shows cube faceting (cubic faceting)。
